events.name: BrowseItemLoadFailed

events.name: DELETE

events.name: REFETCH_FILTER

events.name: REFETCH_PAGE

overridableConfigKeys.label: Body content tree
overridableConfigKeys.description: Render-ui SExpr rendered after rows load when browseLook = table (the default). Toolbar (search when bodySearch, filter bar when filters is non-empty) above the canonical data-grid call. Until 2026-08-27 this was the only one of the six looks with no search affordance at all. See denseBodyContent/feedBodyContent/galleryBodyContent for the other browseLook bodies; any may be overridden directly while inheriting the same trait, state machine, emits, and listens. Inlined directly (not via a composed sibling trait) 2026-09-08 — a separately-listening DataGrid1 sibling fired unconditionally on every BrowseItemLoaded regardless of browseLook, racing the correct body for slot main (a listens guard can't gate this: both the Rust interpreter and the TS codegen path restrict a listens guard's context to @payload only, so a browseLook config check there always evaluates undefined).

overridableConfigKeys.label: Show the list's own search box?
overridableConfigKeys.description: The dense/feed/gallery looks embed their own search box above the rows. Set false when the page already provides a search affordance (a toolbar Search molecule), so the surface shows one search box instead of two.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: inline search, list search, built-in search, show search, duplicate search

overridableConfigKeys.label: Browse look
overridableConfigKeys.description: Layer 2 visual treatment for the whole browse surface. table = the default data-grid (bodyContent); dense = spreadsheet-style table with toolbar search (denseBodyContent); feed = chronological card stream (feedBodyContent); gallery = image-first responsive card grid (galleryBodyContent); master-detail = record-work split view — dense list left, clicked record's detail right (masterDetailBodyContent); triage = inbox-register compact rows for queue work (triageBodyContent). Selecting a non-table look swaps which body tree renders after rows load; any body may still be overridden directly at the call site for a one-off layout.

overridableConfigKeys.label: How many columns in the grid?
overridableConfigKeys.description: Number of columns in the responsive card/grid layout.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: columns, grid width, card columns, num columns

overridableConfigKeys.label: Table columns
overridableConfigKeys.description: Column definitions for table-style variants (dense). Each maps an entity field to a column with optional width / align / weight / format.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Dense look body
overridableConfigKeys.description: Render-ui SExpr rendered after rows load when browseLook = dense. Spreadsheet-style sticky-header data-table with a search bar; composes columns/itemActions/maxInlineActions/displayPageSize/searchPlaceholder. Folded from std-browse-dense (Phase 5.B). Inlined directly (not via a composed sibling trait) 2026-09-08 — see the table-default body's note for why.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Master-detail record pane actions
overridableConfigKeys.description: Action buttons on the master-detail record pane (detail-panel `actions` descriptors: label/event/icon/variant). Consumers add their own record actions (Edit/Delete/…) alongside or instead of Close.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: record actions, detail actions, pane actions

overridableConfigKeys.label: Which pane action closes the record?
overridableConfigKeys.description: The detailActions entry whose event matches renders as the pane's close (×) button.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: close event, dismiss event, pane close

overridableConfigKeys.label: Which fields appear in the master-detail record pane?
overridableConfigKeys.description: Fields shown in the detail panel when browseLook = master-detail; the field declared variant h3/h4 is the pane title. Consumers overriding columns/fields should override this list to match their entity.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: detail columns, record fields, detail pane fields

overridableConfigKeys.label: How many rows to show at once?
overridableConfigKeys.description: Rows visible per page before the pagination control appears.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: visible rows, items per page, display limit, show per page

overridableConfigKeys.label: Empty-state description
overridableConfigKeys.description: What will appear here once rows exist.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: empty text, no data message, empty hint

overridableConfigKeys.label: Empty-state icon
overridableConfigKeys.description: Domain icon shown when there are no rows.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: empty icon, no data icon

overridableConfigKeys.label: Empty-state title
overridableConfigKeys.description: Specific title shown when there are no rows ("No orders yet"). Left blank, a generic line shows.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: empty title, no data title, empty heading

overridableConfigKeys.label: Feed look body
overridableConfigKeys.description: Render-ui SExpr rendered after rows load when browseLook = feed. Chronological item stream on the same `fields` contract every look reads (roles: overline, h3/h4, caption, small/body, badge, avatar), separated per feedSurface. Folded from std-browse-feed (Phase 5.B).

overridableConfigKeys.label: How are feed items separated?
overridableConfigKeys.description: browseLook = feed only. cards = each item its own raised card with space between (community posts, listings); divided = one surface with hairline rows (inboxes, answer lists, notes); plain = no chrome, items on the page background (editorial article lists, changelogs). What each item shows comes from `fields`: overline = eyebrow above the title, h3/h4 = title (its `icon` becomes a leading tile), caption = prose, small/body = meta line, badge = pill, avatar = leading initials.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: feed style, item chrome, card per item, divided list, editorial list, rows or cards

overridableConfigKeys.label: Which fields should appear as columns?
overridableConfigKeys.description: Each entry maps one entity field to a display column with an optional label and variant.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: visible columns, displayed fields, card fields, column list

overridableConfigKeys.label: Filter bar look
overridableConfigKeys.description: Visual treatment for the embedded filter bar, mirroring std-filter's own enum. Only applies when `filters` is non-empty.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: filter bar style, facet style, chips, pills

overridableConfigKeys.label: Which filters should appear above the list?
overridableConfigKeys.description: Dropdown filter facets by field, rendered as an embedded filter bar above the rows; each selection fires REFETCH_FILTER on this trait. Empty (the default) = no filter bar, which is the right setting whenever the page already composes std-filter beside this list and routes `XFilter.FILTER -> REFETCH_FILTER` — that is the wired owner and remains the primary path. Use this knob only for a standalone list with no page-level filter affordance, so the surface shows one filter bar instead of two.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: filter bar, faceted filters, field filters, column filters, dropdowns

children.className: sticky top-0 z-10 py-3 bg-[var(--color-surface)]/95 backdrop-blur

overridableConfigKeys.label: Gallery look body
overridableConfigKeys.description: Render-ui SExpr rendered after rows load when browseLook = gallery. Image-first responsive card grid (auto-fit minCardWidth) on the data-grid fields path: imageField renders the card photo when set (falsy-safe when empty), fields drive title/badges/meta. One tree, no renderItem lambda — lambdas do not survive inside (if) arms (2026-07-27).

overridableConfigKeys.label: Spacing between rows
overridableConfigKeys.description: Gap between grid cells: sm, md, or lg.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: row gap, cell spacing, grid gap, padding between items

overridableConfigKeys.label: Which field holds the row image?
overridableConfigKeys.description: Entity field containing the thumbnail URL for each row.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: image field, thumbnail field, photo field, picture column

overridableConfigKeys.label: Which relation fields to hydrate?
overridableConfigKeys.description: Entity relation field names to hydrate on fetch (e.g. a `tag : Category` field named `tag`), so grid columns can use dot-paths like tag.name. Empty = no hydration, the default.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: relation hydration, populate relations, joined fields, hydrate relations

overridableConfigKeys.label: Which field does the first load filter on?
overridableConfigKeys.description: Name the field the INITIAL load filters on, paired with initialFilterValue. This is the detail half of a list-detail pair: a thread that must wait for a conversation to be picked sets the field to its parent key and leaves the value blank, so the first load matches nothing and the empty state shows instead of every record in the table. REFETCH_FILTER then supplies the real selection. Left blank the first load is unfiltered, which is the default.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: initial filter, first load filter, wait for selection, detail pane filter, requires selection, start empty

overridableConfigKeys.label: What value does the first load filter for?
overridableConfigKeys.description: The value initialFilterField must equal on the first load. Blank is meaningful: it matches only records whose field is itself blank, which for a detail pane is normally none — that is how a thread stays empty until its parent is selected.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: initial filter value, first load value, default selection

overridableConfigKeys.label: What actions can users take on each row?
overridableConfigKeys.description: Buttons rendered on each row (e.g. Edit, Delete, View).
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: row buttons, row actions, item actions, per-row buttons, table actions

overridableConfigKeys.label: Which event does clicking a row fire?
overridableConfigKeys.description: Row-click channel. Retarget when two browse lists coexist in one orbital and their VIEW payloads differ, so each gets its own typed channel.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: row click event, item click, open event, select event

overridableConfigKeys.label: Row entrance
overridableConfigKeys.description: How a row arrives in the list; a row that changes place glides there (dense, feed, gallery and triage looks)
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: animate rows, row animation, list motion

emptyDetail.description: Select a record from the list to see its details.
emptyDetail.title: Nothing selected

overridableConfigKeys.label: Master-detail look body (no selection)
overridableConfigKeys.description: Render-ui SExpr rendered after rows load when browseLook = master-detail: record-work split view — toolbar, dense list left, empty-state pane right until a row is opened. Opening a row renders masterDetailRecordBodyContent. The toolbar honours bodySearch and filters like every other look; it used to render its search box unconditionally, which put a second search box on any page that already composed std-search (observed in std-crm ContactOrbital).

overridableConfigKeys.label: Master-detail look body (record open)
overridableConfigKeys.description: Render-ui SExpr rendered by the VIEW transition when browseLook = master-detail: the same split view with the clicked record's detail panel on the right, fed by the VIEW payload row and detailFields.

overridableConfigKeys.label: How many row actions to show before collapsing?
overridableConfigKeys.description: Actions beyond this count collapse into a '⋯' overflow menu. Set 2–3 for dense tables.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: inline actions limit, overflow threshold, max buttons per row

overridableConfigKeys.label: Which field orders the list?
overridableConfigKeys.description: A field name, or field:desc for newest or largest first (e.g. createdAt:desc). Applied before paging. Empty keeps the stored order.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: sort, sort by, order by, newest first, latest first, sort order

overridableConfigKeys.label: How many rows to fetch per page?
overridableConfigKeys.description: Records fetched from the server per page request.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: fetch limit, records per page, batch size, page limit

overridableConfigKeys.label: Only show records owned by the signed-in user?
overridableConfigKeys.description: Name the field on this entity that holds the viewer's id (e.g. memberId, patientId, assignee). When set, the list loads ONLY rows whose that field equals @user.id — the 'my bookings' / 'my appointments' shape. Left blank the list loads every row, which is the default. Declared, never inferred: guessing the column from its name would silently scope the wrong one.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: owner field, my records, only mine, only my own, scope to user, per-user list, mine only, owned by me

overridableConfigKeys.label: Which column does the search box match against?
overridableConfigKeys.description: Name the field on this entity the search box's str/includes filter matches against. Declared, never inferred: an entity with no `name` column must set this to a real field (e.g. title, content) or the search box can never match a row.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: search column, search on field, match field, search key

overridableConfigKeys.label: Search box placeholder text
overridableConfigKeys.description: Hint text inside the list search box (e.g. 'Search orders…').
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: search hint, placeholder, search box text, search label

overridableConfigKeys.label: Show row selection checkboxes?
overridableConfigKeys.description: Adds a checkbox column with select-all to the dense table. Enable only when the surface offers bulk actions — checkboxes with nothing to act on are a dead affordance.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: row checkboxes, multi-select, bulk select, selection column

overridableConfigKeys.label: Paint a surface behind the list?
overridableConfigKeys.description: auto (default) draws the theme's content surface behind every look — on a patterned page background the list reads as one block; the theme decides how that surface looks. none places the list directly on the page (e.g. a list already inside a card or panel you composed).
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: card background, panel, container, list background, no background, transparent, bare

overridableConfigKeys.label: Triage look body
overridableConfigKeys.description: Render-ui SExpr rendered after rows load when browseLook = triage. Inbox-register queue: one surface with a toolbar search and compact list rows (title + badges + inline meta) built for keyboard-pace queue work; row actions collapse per maxInlineActions. Composes fields/itemActions/searchPlaceholder/bodySearch.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Viewer's role
overridableConfigKeys.description: The signed-in viewer's role that each row action's `roles` is checked against. Bind it explicitly at the call site (e.g. `viewerRole: @user.role`) in an app whose identity carries a role; left empty, only actions with no `roles` show.
